name: Flamenco guitar for a cocktail hour: tangos, Dirty Flamenco
description: Dirty Flamenco plays tangos, a quick, bright style of traditional flamenco, at a cocktail hour, with the volume low enough for guests to keep talking.
more: Tangos is one of the traditional forms on Dirty Flamenco's song list, along with solea and guajiras. The trio doesn't need a dance floor, and they can play anywhere from background level up to full volume. If your venue has a sound limit, tell us and they'll play within it.
